description: Get one dataset by `id` (from listDatasets, or a persona item's datasetId): name, description and its items, as in listDatasets. Secret values are always masked here: this server never returns them in clear. Use when: a persona names a dataset and you want to say what it holds. Read-only. Needs data:read. Returns 404 if the dataset is not in your workspace.
name: getDataset

outputSchema.description:
Workspace-scoped collection of named data items used to parameterise tests.
Returned by `GET /datasets`, `GET /datasets/{id}`. The `resolve` variant returns
the same shape with `secret` values unmasked.

createdBy.description: User id that created the dataset.

items.description:
A single named variable inside a dataset. Referenced from tests via
`{{key}}` template syntax (resolved at runtime against the dataset).

id.description: Stable item id (uuid). Use this from a `ProfileDataItem.itemId`.

key.description:
Identifier-shaped variable name (letters/numbers/underscore, not starting with a
number). Referenced inline in test scripts via `{{key}}`.

type.description:
Discriminator for individual data items. `secret` items are masked
(`••••••••`) in `GET /datasets` and `GET /datasets/{id}` responses; the
runtime-only `GET /datasets/{id}/resolve` endpoint returns the cleartext.

value.description:
Variable value (always serialized as a string). Returned masked as `••••••••`
when `type` is `secret`, except on `GET /datasets/{id}/resolve` or
`GET /datasets/{id}?showSecrets=true`.

title: Get Dataset
